article.title: For Honor Deserves an Anime: Here's the Series RogueVerse Would Make
article.angle: A serious war-fantasy anime adaptation concept centered on inherited hatred, manipulated conflict, faction identity, and uneasy cooperation.

rights_notice: Unofficial RogueVerse fan concept inspired by Ubisoft's For Honor. For Honor and related names, characters, trademarks, and intellectual property belong to Ubisoft and their respective rights holders.
beats: The Shattering fractured the old world and separated civilizations.
Ashfeld, Heathmoor, and the Myre grew into distinct societies locked in inherited conflict.
Warden escorts desperately needed supplies through disputed territory.
Raider attacks because Heathmoor needs the same supplies.
Warden and Raider duel while their armies clash.
The battlefield splits open during an earthquake.
Ancient ruins are exposed beneath the battlefield.
A mysterious relic fragment is found inside.
Masked warriors appear, seize the fragment, and escape.
Warden and Raider realize their battle may have been engineered.

cards.headline: FOR HONOR: THE ANIME
cards.body: ACT I — THE FRACTURE. Nobody remembers who started the war.

cards.headline: THE WORLD BROKE FIRST
cards.body: The Shattering tore continents apart. The survivors rebuilt, but not together.

cards.headline: THREE WORLDS ROSE
cards.body: Ashfeld. Heathmoor. The Myre. Order, freedom, and tradition hardened into rival civilizations.

cards.headline: AND THEN THEY FOUGHT
cards.body: Land. Food. Borders. Old grudges. Eventually, war became inheritance.

cards.headline: WARDEN
cards.body: A Knight commander escorts supplies through disputed territory, believing Ashfeld's army protects civilization.

cards.headline: RAIDER
cards.body: Heathmoor is starving. Raider needs the same supplies. Two armies. One shipment. No clean answer.

cards.headline: KNIGHT VS. VIKING
cards.body: Sword against axe. Discipline against overwhelming force. Neither warrior intends to move.

cards.headline: THEN THE EARTH MOVES
cards.body: The battlefield splits open beneath both armies.

cards.headline: BENEATH THE WAR
cards.body: An ancient structure appears, older than either civilization and still somehow functioning.

cards.headline: THE RELIC
cards.body: A fragment of strange metal waits inside. Neither faction recognizes it. Someone else does.

cards.headline: THEY WERE WAITING
cards.body: Masked warriors emerge, ignore both armies, seize the relic, and disappear.

scenes.headline: The world broke first
scenes.body: The Shattering divided civilization into rival powers.

scenes.headline: Three worlds rose
scenes.body: Knights of Ashfeld, Vikings of Heathmoor, and Samurai of the Myre inherited generations of war.

scenes.headline: One shipment
scenes.body: Warden escorts supplies that Raider's starving people also need.

scenes.headline: Knight vs. Viking
scenes.body: Their duel becomes the center of a battle neither side can afford to lose.

scenes.headline: The earth opens
scenes.body: An earthquake exposes ancient ruins directly beneath the battlefield.

scenes.headline: The relic
scenes.body: Inside is a mysterious fragment that neither faction recognizes.

scenes.headline: They were waiting
scenes.body: Masked warriors seize the relic and escape without choosing a side.

scenes.headline: The real question
scenes.body: Someone wanted Warden and Raider to fight here. Act II: The Convergence.
